before.dateConfidenceReasoning: Cleanview state-leads planned COD: September 2027 (Invenergy High Noon Solar Energy LLC).
before.longFormSummary:
• The Public Service Commission of Wisconsin (PSCW) approved the Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) under Docket 9814-CE-100 for Invenergy's High Noon Solar Energy Center in July 2023.
  • Features 300 MW of utility-scale solar generation capacity paired with a 165 MW / 660 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS).
  • Spans approximately 4,327 acres across the Towns of Leeds, Lowville, Arlington, and Hampden in south-central Columbia County, Wisconsin.
  • Represents an estimated 650 million USD total capital investment, delivering clean electricity sufficient to power roughly 90,000 homes.
  • In April 2025, PSCW regulators approved a joint utility acquisition where WEC Energy Group (We Energies & WPS) acquired 270 MW of solar and 148.5 MW of storage, while Madison Gas and Electric (MGE) acquired the remaining 10% share.
  • Timeline: planned project targeting commercial operation in September 2027 (estimated) under MISO interconnection queue and state regulatory schedules.

before.longFormSummary:
• The Oregon Energy Facility Siting Council (EFSC) issued the final site certificate approval in November 2024 for the 1,200 MW Sunstone Solar Project in Morrow County, Oregon.
  • Features 1,200 MW of utility-scale photovoltaic capacity paired with a 1,200 MW / 7,200 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS), making it the largest approved renewable energy facility in the Pacific Northwest.
  • Encompasses roughly 9,442 acres of private agricultural land within a 10,960-acre boundary near Echo and Boardman in eastern Oregon.
  • Originally permitted by Pine Gate Renewables, Amazon (Amazon Energy LLC) acquired full project rights and site control for 83 million USD at a court-supervised auction in January 2026.
  • Output will directly supply carbon-free power to Amazon Web Services (AWS) data center campuses in Umatilla and Morrow counties.
  • Timeline: planned project targeting commercial operation in December 2027 (estimated) under WECC interconnection queue and state regulatory schedules.
